title: 第25章 大发横财再翻一倍第26章 灵脉升级筑基谋划
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
几天后，死去的家族修士全都入土为安，重伤致残人员还在疗伤，轻伤人员已经基本恢复。
紧接着，族长李光敖召开了一次家族会议，所有炼气四层以上修士全都参与。
这次会议，炼气四层修士少了李定学，他被斩掉一臂，失血昏迷，还在养伤。
具体会议内容，李青元不得而知。
比起家族会议内容，李青元对自己手上的资源更感兴趣。
他来到自己清修的小院，对外闭关修炼。
“一阶下品储物袋，收！”
李青元意念一动，储物袋收入玄牝空间，完美复制后，两个一模一样的储物袋落入手中。
他的掌心上，两个储物袋一模一样，连略微破损的痕迹、陈旧的样子，都是丝毫不差。
“爹说过，崭新的一阶下品储物袋，价值约一百块灵石。”李青元沉吟道：“我手上的储物袋，用了好些年，算是二手货。”
“估计也就七八十块灵石的样子。”
随后，李青元手持飞剑，屈指一弹，
铛，三尺飞剑，清脆嗡鸣。
剑身修长，剑刃锋利，通体青绿，闪烁灵纹。
李青元欣喜道：“这可是一阶中品法器飞剑啊。”
“按照爹说的，放在坊市中，这把剑少说一百多块灵石。足够让我使用到炼气六层了。”
“嘿嘿，果然是背靠家族好修仙！”
即便只是三流炼气家族，在修炼初期，所能接触的修炼资源依旧远胜毫无背景的散修。
“收！”
“复制！”

很快，玄牝空间中飞出两把飞剑。
一阶中品法器飞剑，通体青绿，以绿剑竹为主料，辅佐其他一阶材料、矿石打造而成。
故而，名曰：绿竹飞剑。
李青元笑歪了嘴：“两把绿竹飞剑，售价大约300块灵石。”
最后是五十块灵石。
复制翻倍后，变成一百灵石。
李青元满意道：“一百灵石，足够我修炼一段时间了。”
“过几天，爹爹他们应该要去坊市售卖灵植和妖兽药材，我可以让他暗中购买一些绘画一阶上品符纸的材料。”
“在这凶险万分的柳鹤岛，唯有掌控炼气后期战力，才能给我几分安全感。”
自从来到修仙世界后，李青元总有一种不安全感。
这种不安全感，源自于自身的弱小。
他知道，一切恐惧，来源于火力不足。
如今的他，想要火力充足，只能多多绘制炎冰斩魄符。
“闭关修炼前，还有一件事要办～”李青元一脸苦恼，低声道：“唉，我该怎么和族长爷爷解释呢？”
“看来，只能上套路了。”
翌日一早，李青元脱掉上衣，负荆请罪，来到族长独居小院门外，双膝跪地道：“族孙李青元，特来请罪。”
“恳请族长爷爷责罚。”
吱呀一声，房门打开。
正巧，除了族长，大长老也在。
李青元恭敬道：“见过族长爷爷、大长老爷爷。”

大长老一脸好奇道：“小青元你这是干什么？你犯了什么错？”
李青元低头不语。
content_en:
A few days later, all the deceased family monks were laid to rest. Those who were seriously injured and disabled were still recovering from their injuries, and those who were slightly injured had basically recovered.
Immediately afterwards, the patriarch Li Guangao held a family meeting, and all monks above the fourth level of Qi Refining participated.
At this meeting, the fourth-level Qi Refining monk was missing Li Dingxue. He had an arm cut off and was unconscious due to blood loss. He was still recovering from his injuries.
Li Qingyuan did not know the specific content of the meeting.
Li Qingyuan was more interested in the resources he had than the content of the family meeting.
He came to the small courtyard where he cultivated himself and practiced in seclusion.
"First-class low-grade storage bag, collect it!"
With a thought, Li Qingyuan put the storage bag into Xuan Mi's space. After being copied perfectly, two identical storage bags fell into his hands.
On the palm of his hand, the two storage bags were exactly the same, even the signs of slight damage and age were exactly the same.
"Dad said that a brand new first-level low-grade storage bag is worth about one hundred spirit stones." Li Qingyuan said thoughtfully: "The storage bag I have has been used for several years, so it is considered second-hand."
"It's estimated to be only seventy or eighty spirit stones."
Then, Li Qingyuan held the flying sword and flicked it with one finger.
Dang, the three-foot flying sword buzzed loudly.
The sword body is slender, the blade is sharp, the whole body is green, and there are flashing spiritual patterns.
Li Qingyuan said happily: "This is a first-level mid-grade magical weapon, the Flying Sword."
"According to what dad said, if you put this sword in the market, it would cost more than a hundred spiritual stones at least. It is enough for me to use it to the sixth level of Qi Refining."
"Hehe, it turns out that he cultivates immortality with the help of his family!"
Even if they are only a third-rate Qi-refining family, in the early stage of cultivation, the cultivation resources they have access to are still far better than those of casual cultivators with no background.
"Take it!"
"Copy!"
Soon, two flying swords flew out of Xuan Mi's space.
The flying sword, a first-level middle-grade magic weapon, is completely green and is made of green sword bamboo as the main material, supplemented by other first-level materials and ores.
Therefore, it is called: Green Bamboo Flying Sword.
Li Qingyuan smiled crookedly: "Two green bamboo flying swords cost about 300 spiritual stones."
Finally, there are fifty spiritual stones.
After the copy is doubled, it becomes one hundred spirit stones.
Li Qingyuan said with satisfaction: "One hundred spirit stones are enough for me to practice for a period of time."
"In a few days, dad and the others should go to the market to sell spiritual plants and monster medicinal materials. I can ask him to secretly purchase some materials for painting first-grade high-grade talisman paper."
"On this extremely dangerous Liuhe Island, only by controlling the combat power in the later stages of Qi refining can I feel a sense of security."
Ever since he came to the world of cultivating immortals, Li Qingyuan has always felt a sense of insecurity.
This insecurity comes from one's own weakness.
He knew that all fear came from insufficient firepower.
Now, if he wants to have enough firepower, he can only draw more Flame Ice Zhanpaku Talismans.
"Before retreating to practice, there is one more thing to do~" Li Qingyuan looked troubled and whispered: "Oh, how should I explain to the patriarch?"
"It seems that we can only resort to tricks."
Early the next morning, Li Qingyuan took off his shirt, carried a thorn tree to plead guilty, came to the door of the small courtyard where the patriarch lived alone, knelt on his knees and said: "Li Qingyuan, the grandson of the clan, came here to plead guilty."
"I beg the patriarch to punish me."
With a creak, the door opened.
Coincidentally, in addition to the clan leader, the great elder was also there.
Li Qingyuan said respectfully: "I have met the patriarch and the great elder."
The great elder looked curious: "Xiao Qingyuan, what are you doing? What mistake did you make?"
Li Qingyuan lowered his head and said nothing.
